title: Rectangular waveguide modes (2D)
description: Cut-off wavenumbers of the TE and TM modes of a WR-90 guide from a finite-difference Helmholtz eigenproblem on its cross-section (Neumann for H_z, Dirichlet for E_z), refined twice, against k_c = sqrt((m pi/a)^2 + (n pi/b)^2); the dispersion beta(f) follows.
